question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Although humans have no power to change the sun’s radiation or the orbit of the earth, they can still influence the environment in other ways. The sharp rise in (a) ------- gases in the atmosphere is a result of human actions. Among these gases, carbon dioxide has seen a dangerous increase in the last hundred years. This is mainly due to the burning of (b) ------- fuels like coal, oil, and natural gas. Industrial growth since the 19th century led to the construction of many factories, all needing energy from these fuels. At present, around 85 million barrels of crude oil are used every day. Each time such fuels are burned, carbon dioxide is released into the air. Furthermore, (c) ------- is another activity that intensifies the greenhouse effect. People clear huge areas of forest to make space for agriculture, mining, or collecting wood. This practice leads to two serious issues. First, burning trees emits a great deal of carbon dioxide. Second, the natural (d) ------- that used to absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen gets destroyed. Thus, if we want to protect the atmosphere and reduce the impact of global warming, we must reduce emissions and save our (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
